title: RBAC Permission Matrix
goal: Define role-based access control permission matrix for super_boss, manager, and employee roles.
result_summary: Created PERMISSIONS matrix: super_boss (10 perms: all access), manager (6 perms: view/assign leads, reports, manage agents, view/edit inventory), employee (3 perms: view assigned leads, update status, view inventory). Helper functions hasPermission() and getAllPermissions().
